title: Bird Talk
description: NCERT Class 3 English (Marigold): 'Bird Talk'. New words, comprehension, joining words (and, but), and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'Bird Talk': sparrow, nest, chirp, feather.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'Bird Talk' mean (sparrow, nest, chirp, feather); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: A bird builds its ___ in a tree.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The sound a small bird makes is a ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: The sparrow chirps and builds its nest.
It is small but very quick.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'Bird Talk' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'Bird Talk'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: In the poem, the birds talk about ___.
In the poem, the birds chat about the ways of ___.

exemplars: The sparrow chirps and builds its nest.
It is small but very quick.

nodes.title: Joining Words (and, but)
nodes.teach_focus: Joining words link two ideas: 'and' adds, 'but' shows a difference.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses joining words (and, but) correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of joining words (and, but).

bridge_exercises.sentence: Join with the right word: 'I like tea ___ not coffee.'
I have a pen ___ a book.
bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: I have a pen and a book.
It is small but very fast.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'Bird Talk'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'Bird Talk': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Birds are small ___ they can fly far.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.sentence: I have a pen ___ a book.
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: The sparrow chirps and builds its nest.
It is small but very quick.

items.prompt: The sound a small bird makes is a ___.
A bird builds its ___ in a tree.
In the poem, the birds talk about ___.
In the poem, the birds chat about the ways of ___.
Join with the right word: 'I like tea ___ not coffee.'
I have a pen ___ a book.
